title: SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2610.25844v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training high-quality diffusion models is computationally expensive, and inference-time guidance often adds further sampling cost. In this work, we introduce Swift, a simple yet effective self-guided training method that uses a frozen weak denoiser to improve a stronger model without adding inference overhead. For each noisy input, Swift extrapolates the clean regression target away from the weak denoiser's prediction, amplifying components that remain underfit. The weak guide can be an early training checkpoint, requires no backpropagation during main-model training, and is discarded afterward. The resulting model retains the original sampler and supports both conditional and unconditional generation without label dropout or an unconditional branch. translated_title: SWIFT：通过目标外推实现自引导的弱到强扩散模型
translated_abstract: 训练高质量扩散模型的计算成本很高，而推理时引导通常会进一步增加采样开销。在这项工作中，我们提出了Swift，一种简单而有效的自引导训练方法，它利用冻结的弱去噪器来改进更强的模型，且不增加推理开销。对于每个带噪输入，Swift将干净的回归目标从弱去噪器的预测方向向外推，从而放大仍处于拟合不足状态的成分。弱引导器可以是早期训练的检查点，在主模型训练期间无需反向传播，训练结束后即可丢弃。所得模型保留了原始采样器，并支持条件与无条件生成，无需标签丢弃或无条件分支。我们通过RKHS（再生核希尔伯特空间）中有限时间总体梯度流的谱分析来解释这一机制。在使用早期停止的弱引导器的情况下，我们证明了存在一个非空的外推范围（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: SWIFT利用冻结的弱去噪器作为自引导信号，通过将回归目标外推来放大拟合不足的成分，从而在不增加推理开销的前提下改进强扩散模型的训练质量。
en_tdlr: SWIFT is a self-guided training method that uses a frozen weak denoiser with target extrapolation to amplify underfit components, improving strong diffusion models without any inference-time overhead.
